title: Fate is destroyed
summary: Thinking mortals become purposed and the world is thrown into imbalance.

title: Garioch strikes Rues from the world
summary: Rues is isolated behind its barrier and the Lattice is broken.

title: The Night of Guardian's Glory
summary: The renegade Zenith Ravvin makes a bid for divinity and is prevented.

title: The Great Rebalancing
summary: Death, Magic, and Purpose are brought into balance and protected from Corruption.

title: Lattice travel is rediscovered
summary: Threshold travel begins reconnecting the isolated nations of Aeledd.

title: The Desuetude Pronouncement
summary: Large churches are disbanded in favor of good-works based convocations.

title: Nira's mark revealed in Spyndelmere
summary: Regent Berkeley Evers reveals Nira's mark and takes his seat on the Compass Rose.

title: An Empress crowned on Rues
summary: Evenia Mercurio Pentratheron is crowned Empress of the Mecurian Empire.

title: Valaq is abandoned in Merrigor
summary: Valaq is abandoned to the forest and Lasaldi is named the seventh city in its place.

title: Heroes of Old Fortune's Bend appear
summary: New heroes begin appearing throughout the world, gathering at Fortune's Bend.

title: A Diamondback skin is found in T'barris
summary: The discovery leads to the elevation of King Y'vain Pelle.

title: Valarmore is destroyed
summary: The Vargoth invasion claims the city of Valarmore.

title: Eviar Leonate elected Crown Prince of Ophrailes
summary: Eviar Leonate is elected Crown Prince of Ophrailes.

title: Twin floods sweep Aluvair
summary: Two major floods in rapid succession reshape the alluvial plain.

title: The Farthest Star conference is attacked
summary: Called at Fortune's Bend to discuss the Vargoth threat, the conference is attacked by the Vargoth. The current campaign begins.

title: The Vargoth Empire proclaims itself — and Eltiel falls
summary: The Vargoth seek diplomatic relations as a nation; Eltiel falls suddenly without explanation and mists blanket what was once the Skyways.
